verdict.rationale: Three.js's core JS API is inherently fully scriptable for creating scenes, cameras, meshes, and materials (threejs-gh-4/5), and its docs (llms.txt) describe node-based material construction (threejs-docs-2/13/21) — this covers 'create scenes and nodes, edit properties' programmatically. However, there's no evidence of a documented interface for an agent to drive the separate GUI three.js editor (threejs-docs-7) or trigger any build process; only a browser devtools extension is mentioned (threejs-docs-8) with no API docs. Missing for 10: documented editor automation/scripting API, evidence of programmatic build triggering, and any agent-oriented control surface for the editor app itself.
